<?xml version="1.0" encoding="windows-1251"?>

<string_table>

	<string id="ui_mcm_menu_remember_outfit_belt">
		<text>Remember Outfit Belt</text>
	</string>

	<string id="ui_mcm_remember_outfit_belt_title">
		<text>Remember Outfit Belt</text>
	</string>

	<string id="ui_mcm_remember_outfit_belt_title_desc">
		<text>Creates a save-persistent registry of the equipped belt items on an outfit.</text>
	</string>

	<string id="ui_mcm_remember_outfit_belt_memory_limit">
		<text>Memory limit</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_remember_outfit_belt_memory_limit_desc">
		<text>Maximum number of outfits whose belt configuration will be rembered.\nWhen this number is exceeded the belt memory of the outfit with the earliest last worn time is deleted.</text>
	</string>

</string_table>
s: Creates a save-persistent registry of the equipped belt items on an outfit.
Maximum number of outfits whose belt configuration will be rembered.\nWhen this number is exceeded the belt memory of the outfit with the earliest last worn time is deleted.
